title: tool-agent case
description: One customer conversation for a tool-using agent, with the outcome the business expects (final state of the systems the agent acts on) and, optionally, the tool calls that must happen.

goal.description: for the user simulator: what the simulated customer wants

tags.description: slices: intent (refund, address, status), policy edge (over-limit, shipped), risk

critical.description: policy edges that must never fail, on any repeat

review_status.description: draft cases (generated or harvested) are skipped until an expert marks them reviewed

split.description: representative (production-like) or stress (edge / adversarial); default from the stress tags

weight.description: production prevalence weight for representative cases (inverse inclusion probability from cases sample)

purpose.description: regression (default): gated, should keep passing; capability: a target not yet reached, reported but not gated

injection_markers.description: strings that appear only if the system followed an injected instruction (security-guardrails overlay)

final_state.description: subset of the state after the conversation, e.g. {refunds: 0, escalated: true}

tool_sequence.description: tools that must be called in this order (other calls may be in between)

context.description: multi-turn: {use: [{name, args, after_turn}], never_use: [{name, args}]} for context_retained

user_rules.description: deterministic simulated user: [{when: regex on the agent's last reply, say: next message}, {otherwise: ...}]

max_turns.description: most user turns in a multi-turn case (default: the scripted turns, else 6)
